title: Thermodynamically stable crystal modification of 2-({2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione
abstract: Es wird eine thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation des herbiziden Wirkstoffs 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl) cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione) beschrieben. Diese thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation weist besondere Vorteile in der Stabilität von Suspensionformulierungen auf.
patent_summary: The document discloses a thermodynamically stable crystal modification of the herbicidal active ingredient tembotrione, 2-({2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione, designated crystal modification I and crystallising in an orthorhombic system in the space group Pna21, together with the statement at [0008] (line 73) that tembotrione occurs in at least two metastable modifications, of which two are named and characterised, II and III; that characterisation is uneven, in that modifications I and II carry single-crystal bond lengths and angles, X-ray powder patterns and unit-cell and density data (Tables 3 to 7, [0013] to [0017]) while modification III carries only a DSC melting point and Raman and infrared band maxima (Tables 1 and 2). No bond is formed or broken anywhere in the document, and its preparations run in both directions: three worked examples crystallise modification I from acetone and the metastable modifications II and III from ethanol and from toluene ([0055] to [0057], lines 659 to 672), while the general process of [0021] to [0026] runs the other way, converting the metastable modifications or mixtures of them into the stable one by suspending and/or dissolving them in solvents such as lower alcohols or ketones and treating them until the conversion is quantitative, or by grinding them under high pressure; the remaining subject matter is herbicidal compositions containing modification I and their use against unwanted plants.
novelty_claims: What the patent positions as new is the solid form itself: claim 1 (line 680) claims the crystal modification of tembotrione "in einem orthorhombischen System" (in an orthorhombic system), claim 2 (682) adds "die Raumgruppe Pna21" (the space group Pna21), claim 7 (799) recites a form "mit einem Schmelzpunkt von 124,0°C" (with a melting point of 124.0 degrees C), which separates the forms by very little, since [0011] (79) gives modification II a melting point of 123,9°C, 0.1 K away and measured by DSC at a heating rate of 10 K min-1 per [0019] (565), and claims 8 and 10 claim the two routes to the stable form, either suspending and/or dissolving "eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione" (a metastable crystal modification or a mixture of the metastable crystal modifications of tembotrione) in solvents and then treating it "bis zur quantitativen Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C behandelt" (until quantitative conversion into the thermodynamically stable crystal modification, at temperatures of 0 to 80 degrees C) (802 to 803), or milling that same material "unter hohem Druck, mindestens 5 bar" (under high pressure, at least 5 bar) (809). That is offered against a specific objection to the prior art: [0004] (65) states that the tembotrione preparable according to the disclosure of WO 00/21924 leads in suspension formulations "zu Kristallwachstum und in Folge dessen zu Ausklumpen und Ausfällungen" (to crystal growth and, as a consequence, to clumping and precipitation) so that the formulation becomes unusable, and [0005] (67) sets the object of providing a modification that overcomes this; the European search report nevertheless cites two documents as X-category, particularly relevant taken alone, against all of claims 1 to 16: WO 03/047340 (895) and WO 2007/006415 (896). The evidence offered for the claimed benefit is a single qualitative sentence, [0058] (676), reporting that an oil dispersion of modification I shows "keine Anzeichen von Ausklumpen und Ausfällungen" (no signs of clumping or precipitation) after several weeks of storage by comparison with an oil dispersion of modification II, III or a mixture of them, with no formulation composition, no storage temperature, no defined duration and no measured value given; no yield, no isolated product mass and no chemical assay purity is reported for any preparation anywhere in the document, the only mass charged being the 2 g of tembotrione in each of the three examples (661, 668, 672), and the quantities the document does state are of other kinds, namely process temperatures and cooling rates, the milling pressure of at least 5 bar, application rates of 1 g to 1 kg of active ingredient per hectare ([0050], 644), a formulation content of 0.1 to 95 percent by weight ([0043], 630), and the graded polymorphic contents of more than 20, 90, 95 and 98 percent by weight in [0027] (590) and "mehr als 80 Gew.-% der stabilen Kristallmodifikation" (more than 80 percent by weight of the stable crystal modification) in claim 12 (816), which state how much of the solid is modification I and not how pure the tembotrione is. Two inconsistencies in the document are recorded as printed and repaired in neither direction: first, Table 5 (printed Tabelle 5, 472 to 508), captioned as the X-ray powder pattern of modification I, and Table 6 (printed Tabelle 6, 513 to 544), captioned as that of modification II, print the same 49 values of 2 theta in the same order, 7.3765 through 36.7974, and claim 5 (755 to 770) recites that same list, which was checked value by value against the source, and a mislabelled caption does not explain it, because Tabelle 7 (546 to 553) gives modification I as orthorhombic in space group Pna21 with a unit-cell volume of 1788,91 Å3 and modification II as monoclinic in P2(1)/n with 1814,21 Å3, and two different lattices cannot give one powder pattern, so what is left is that one of the two tables duplicates the other, while the document does not reveal which of them carries the misprinted data, and nothing here decides that, corrects either table or asserts what the powder pattern of modification II actually is; second, the preference ladder of [0024] (584) runs "bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C", then "besonders bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 60°C bis 80°C", then "ganz besonders bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 50°C bis 80°C" (preferred 0 to 80 degrees C, particularly preferred 60 to 80, very particularly preferred 50 to 80), so the most preferred band is wider than the band it should narrow.
